column1: # Retry manifest -- the cube-pnp-new rows that had no checkpoint after array
# 36767528/36767641. Kept as a record of what was resubmitted, and as the
# pattern for the next retry: a manifest of exactly the outstanding rows beats
# --datasets/--only filters, which cannot express "these five and no others".
#   diffusion x3  erc-hpc-comp035 allocated a GPU torch cannot open. The driver
#                 refuses that rather than training on the CPU, so they died in
#                 seconds. comp035 joins comp037 and comp040 in --exclude.
#   pi05 x2       erc-hpc-comp247, OOM behind a CO-TENANT holding 120 GB of a
#                 140 GB card while ours had 19.68 GB and needed 242 MiB more.
#                 Not batch size: batch 4 was already in force. Nothing here can
#                 reserve a card, so the sbatch now asks the allocator not to
# dataset            policy     cameras                          steps   batch  hours  extra
